alternates.evidence_quote: During his days in fashion, citizenM founder Rattan Chadha sent designers to the world’s fashion capitals, and all returned with the same complaint: uninspiring hotels. This sparked an idea for a hotel where art and human connection are just as important as a comfy bed and a good cocktail.
